facts.statement: The Holiday Pass sale offer ended January 4, 2013.

article_summaries.title: Last Chance to Get the Free Realms Holiday Pass!
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com promotional news post urging players to buy the Holiday Pass, a three-month non-recurring membership sold for $9.99, with a free Argyle Sweater in-game as an incentive. The offer ended January 4, 2013. The post says membership brings marketplace discounts and access to higher job levels.
